signIn.title: Sign in to the staff console
signIn.invalid: That email and password don't match.

challenge.title: Two-step verification
challenge.explainTotp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
challenge.explainBackup: Enter one of your backup codes. Each code works once.

errors.invalid_code: That code didn't work. Try again.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again to get another try.
errors.locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
errors.expired: This sign-in has expired. Sign in again.

signIn.passkeyFailed: That passkey didn't work. Try again, or sign in with your password.

notStaff.title: Not a staff account
notStaff.description: This account is not on the Yayatoh staff list, or can't do that. Ask the platform owner if you need access.

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.description: Every organization on the platform. Each view is recorded in the access log.

done.paused: Paused. It applies to the organizer's next request.
done.status_suspend: Suspended. Its public pages and ticket sales are offline and its console is read-only.
done.status_reactivate: Reactivated. Its public pages, listings and ticket sales are back.
done.status_terminate: Terminated. Its public pages are offline for good; its owners can still export their data.
done.status_restore: Organization restored to the status it had before it was terminated. Its owners are told.

switches.title: Kill switches
switches.description: Pausing takes effect on the organizer's next request. The organizer sees what is paused, not your reason.

flow.platform_mor: Orders are charged by the platform (platform_mor).
flow.organizer_mor: Orders are charged on the connected account (organizer_mor).

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.note: Debits are positive. Organizer payables are negative: money owed to the organizer.

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.summary: Summary for the card network (what was bought, that it was delivered or used)

impersonate.title: Act as a member
impersonate.description: Open the organizer console as one of this org's members to help them, for at most one hour. Refunds, payouts, exports, deletions and confirmations stay off. The org's owners are told at once, and everything you do is in their activity log with your name.
impersonate.reasonHint: For example the support ticket and what you will check. Required.
impersonate.adminsOnly: Only admin staff can act as a member.
impersonate.empty: No staff have acted as a member of this org.

errors.reason_required: Give a reason: the org's owners see it.
errors.member_required: Choose the member to act as.
errors.staff_target: Platform staff can't be acted as.
errors.not_found: That person isn't a member of this org.

status.title: Organization status

explain.active: Public pages, listings and ticket sales are on.
explain.limited: Public pages, listings and ticket sales are on, with limits.
explain.suspended: Public pages, listings, the widget and ticket sales are offline and the console is read-only for its members. Tickets already sold stay valid and still scan.
explain.terminated: Closed. Public pages are offline, nothing can be changed, and only its owners can still open the console to export their data. No data was deleted.

effect.suspend: Takes its public pages, marketplace listings, tenant site, widget and checkout offline at once and makes its console read-only. Existing orders stay valid and tickets still scan. The owners are told (without your reason).
effect.reactivate: Brings its public pages, listings and checkout back and makes its console writable again. The owners are told.
effect.terminate: Closes it for good: public pages go offline, ticket scanning stops and members lose the console, except owners, who can still export their data. Only the reviewed restore (runbook, with the platform owner's approval) can undo it. Nothing is deleted.

confirm.suspend: I understand its public pages go offline and its console becomes read-only.
confirm.reactivate: I understand its public pages and checkout come back.

status.adminsOnly: Only admins can change an organization's status.
status.final: Terminated organizations can't be reactivated with these forms. A mistaken termination is restored with the reviewed restore below.

errors.status_reason: Give a reason of at least 3 characters: it is kept in the audit log.
errors.status_slug: Type the organization's address exactly to confirm.
errors.restore_step_up: That password or code isn't right. Confirm it's you and try again.
errors.restore_rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes before confirming it's you again.
errors.restore_method: Set a password or an authenticator app on your account first: restoring needs you to confirm it's you.

restore.title: Restore a terminated organization
restore.description: Only for a termination that was a mistake, after the platform owner approved restoring it in writing (runbook: “Restore a terminated organization”). Put the approval's reference in the reason.
restore.effect: Puts back the status it had when it was terminated: {status}. Nothing else changes: kill switches, payout holds, API keys, devices, domains and members stay as they are. Its owners are told (without your reason).
restore.noRecord: No termination is recorded for this organization, so there is no status to put back. Don't change it by hand: escalate as the runbook says.
restore.code: Code from your authenticator app (confirm it's you)
restore.adminsOnly: Only admins can restore an organization.

reconciliation.title: Reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Open differences between this tenant's ledger and the payment provider's balance transactions (daily run). Resolve with a note once explained; the note is audited.

accessLog.title: Access log
accessLog.description: Every cross-tenant read by staff and the worker, newest first (latest 200).

evidence.title: Dispute evidence · {id}
evidence.subtitle: Prepared for the card network by {seller} and Yayatoh
evidence.footer: Generated from Yayatoh records: orders, tickets and check-in scans. Reviewed by a person before submission.
evidence.soldByPlatform: Pani Digital Services, LLC (Yayatoh), on behalf of the organizer
evidence.noRefunds: No refunds were requested for this order.
evidence.noPolicy: The organizer has not published a refund policy.
evidence.noScans: No door scans were recorded for these tickets.
evidence.noMessages: No messages were sent to the buyer about this order.
evidence.trimmed: {n, plural, one {# more row left out} other {# more rows left out}} to stay within the card networks’ page limit.

commission.title: Commission
commission.description: Platform fees per organization and currency, from the ledger: fees on sales (online and box office) minus fees given back by refunds. Days are in UTC.
commission.badRange: The end date is before the start date. Showing this month instead.
commission.badDate: Pick both dates. Showing this month instead.
commission.empty: No platform fees in this period.

apiUsage.title: API usage by app version
apiUsage.description: Requests to /v1 per route, client and app version over the last 7 days (UTC). No organization or person is recorded.
apiUsage.summary: {versions, plural, =0 {No client versions seen yet.} one {# client version seen.} other {# client versions seen.}}
apiUsage.empty: No /v1 requests recorded in the last 7 days.

signupCodes.title: Signup codes
signupCodes.description: Signup is invite-only: a code lets someone create an organization. Give each code a note so you know who it's for.

done.revoked: Code revoked. It no longer works for new signups.

create.title: Create a signup code
create.noteHint: Who it's for, e.g. the organizer's name. Kept in the access log.

created.label: New signup code
created.intro: Here is the new code. Copy it now: it won't be shown again.

errors.maxUses: Uses must be a whole number from 1 to 1000.
errors.days: Days must be a whole number from 1 to 365.
errors.note: Add a note of up to 200 characters.

reports.title: Messaging reports
reports.description: Conversations that organizers or their contacts reported to Yayatoh. Resolve (you acted on it) or dismiss (no action needed) with a note for the record.
reports.heading: {org} · {reason}

errors.note_required: Add a note before resolving or dismissing a report.

reports.emptyDescription: Reports from organizers and contacts show up here.

people.title: Privacy requests
people.description: Requests from people about their Yayatoh account (Yayatoh is the controller): find what the platform holds about an email, export it, or erase it. Every lookup is in the access log; every export and erasure is recorded with your reason.
people.reasonHint: Recorded with the request, e.g. the support ticket and how you checked who is asking (10–500 characters).

find.title: Find a person
find.hint: Searches accounts, staff, team invitations, orders, signup codes and security events. The address is sent in the request body, never in a link.

export.title: Export (access request)
export.hint: The same JSON file the person can download from their account page: profile, sessions, security events, organizations and roles, orders and tickets, notification choices, consents and invitations. No passwords, codes or other secrets.

erase.title: Erase (deletion request)
erase.what: Their account is anonymised: signed out everywhere, password and two-step verification removed, name cleared and the email replaced by a hash.
erase.kept: They leave every organization. Organizers keep orders and tickets (legal hold), unlinked from the account.
erase.suppression: The address goes on the platform-wide erased list: no organizer can mail it or import it to a list again unless the person comes back.
erase.final: This can't be undone. A confirmation email goes to the address first.
erase.done: Erased. {orgs, plural, =0 {No organization} one {# organization} other {# organizations}} updated, {sessions, plural, =0 {no sessions} one {# session} other {# sessions}} ended. Request {id}.

errors.reason_required: Give a reason of 10 to 500 characters.
errors.confirm_mismatch: That doesn't match. Type the same email address to confirm.
errors.last_owner: They are the only owner of these organizations. Another owner must be added (or the organization closed) first:
errors.is_staff: This person is active staff. Revoke their staff role first (owner CLI).
errors.not_found: Nothing is held about this email.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.description: Sign in to the staff console with a passkey on this device or a security key. A passkey that asks for your PIN or fingerprint counts as both sign-in steps.
passkeys.added: Passkey added. Next time, choose “Sign in with a passkey”.
passkeys.addFailed: The passkey wasn't added. Try again.
passkeys.notFresh: For your security, sign in again (in the last 10 minutes) before adding a passkey.

messagingPolicy.title: Auto-paused messaging
messagingPolicy.description: Organizations whose reminders, updates and marketing paused themselves because complaints went over 0.3%. Review each with the organizer, then lift it on its messaging page.
messagingPolicy.rateValue: {rate} ({complaints, plural, one {# complaint} other {# complaints}} in {sent} emails)
messagingPolicy.tenantDescription: Complaint-rate auto-pause and this month's usage against the organization's quotas. Every change is audited.

done.lifted: The auto-pause was lifted. Messaging resumed.
done.quota_reset: The quota is back to the default.

errors.validation_failed: Check the values: a whole number and a reason of at least 3 characters.
errors.forbidden: Your staff role can't do that.

openSignup.title: Open signup
openSignup.description: Whether anyone can create an organizer account and organization without a signup code. Off until the public launch.

explain.on: Anyone with a verified email can create an organization under the current fee model. New organizations start in setup mode (no guest messaging) until their required onboarding steps are done. Signup codes keep working.
explain.off: The public signup page says self-serve signup is coming soon. Organizations are created only with a signup code.

openSignup.reasonHint: Kept in the history and the access log (3–500 characters).
openSignup.confirm: I understand that anyone will be able to create an organization, and that this is the public launch decision.

done.unchanged: Nothing changed: the switch was already in that state.

error.reason: Give a reason of 3 to 500 characters.
error.confirm: Tick the box to confirm opening signup.

incidents.title: Status incidents
incidents.descriptionFake: Post and update incidents on the status page. The public status page, the console and the marketplace show them at once. This is the development status page; production uses the status page provider.
incidents.descriptionProvider: Incidents are posted in the status page provider.
incidents.providerNote: This environment uses the status page provider: post and update incidents there (see the on-call runbook).
incidents.empty: No incidents in the last 14 days.

new.title: Post an incident
new.posted: Incident posted. It is on the status page now.

errors.title: Give the incident a title (up to 160 characters).

frontDoor.title: Front door
frontDoor.description: During the move from the legacy site, the new app answers every request on yayatoh.com and abc.yayatoh.com and sends anything it doesn't serve yet to the legacy site. Move read pages one route and one host at a time.
frontDoor.summary: Route table version {version}. Counters cover the last {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} (UTC).
frontDoor.done: Route updated. It applies to new requests within a few seconds.

errors.invalid: Choose a host and a route that exists for it.
errors.step_up: That code or password isn't right. Nothing changed.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.method: Set up an authenticator or a password on your account to confirm it's you before moving routes.

hosts.title: Legacy hosts
hosts.configured: Legacy origin set: front door on
hosts.off: No legacy origin: front door off

routes.title: Moved routes
routes.description: Read pages that can move to the new app. Anything not listed here stays on the legacy site.

change.title: Move a route
change.description: Choose the host, the route and who serves it. Canary serves the new app only to browsers with the yy_canary=next cookie. Anyone with yy_legacy=1 always gets the legacy site.
change.routeOption: {key} ({shape}){only, select, yay { · yayatoh.com only} abc { · abc only} other {}}
change.stateHelp: Legacy is the default. Move back to legacy at any time.

other.title: Other traffic
other.description: Requests outside the moved routes: pages the legacy site still serves, and the new app's own paths.

notFound.title: 404 top list
notFound.description: The most requested missing pages over the last {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, by who served them.

changes.title: Recent changes
changes.empty: No route has been moved yet.
